wordmark.purpose: "Neat" in the top bar. Text only; the window carries no logo mark (the app icon lives with the operating system).

headline.purpose: The one page title per view (Inbox, Activity, Rules, Settings).

title.purpose: Section headings such as "Done this session"; Activity day headings use the same weight at 13px.

title-row.purpose: The group name on a manifest row and the title of a setting row.

body.purpose: Running text, ledger entries, notice lines (including a status-strip notice) and tab labels. Tabular figures.

label.purpose: Column headers, summaries under row titles, setting details, evidence detail, the checkbox label, the status strip folder line, key legend.

label-strong.purpose: The verb column in ledgers (Moved, Recycled, Kept, New rule).

data.purpose: Hosts, file names, sizes, counts, times, rule patterns, the folder path and the version number, wherever they stand as entries.

key.purpose: The legend inside a key cap, and nowhere else. The only text below 12px.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The one ease for every movement: tab underline, row layout, expand, collapse, notices, switch thumb. Defined as --ease-out-expo in styles.css.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover, press and selection.

motion.name: duration-notice
motion.purpose: A status-strip notice rises 6px into place; it leaves by 4px upwards. Completed notices stay six seconds, errors ten.

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: A decided row folds to zero height and fades; chevron rotation; switch thumb slide; a new Done line fades in.

motion.name: duration-layout
motion.purpose: Tab underline slide, rows closing up after a removal, details opening, the title travelling into Done.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" wraps the app; the system setting turns movement off.

breakpoints.name: fold
breakpoints.purpose: At and below this width, From and Confidence fold into each group's summary line, action slots shrink, key caps leave row buttons.

breakpoints.name: window-min
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum window width (900 by 600) set in tauri.conf.json.

breakpoints.name: container-max
breakpoints.purpose: The shared centred container for top bar, page and status strip.

narrative.overview:
Downloads are consignments arriving at a desk. Each one is entered on a ruled manifest with its origin, contents and weight, and each gets one disposition. The whole window is that manifest: a warm near-black sheet ruled with hairlines, warm off-white ink, and a single cobalt stamp for the action being taken. Nothing floats above the sheet. There are no cards, no panels, no shadows and no glow; structure comes from rules, alignment and a few steps of ground.

Density is that of a working ledger rather than a dashboard. Body text sits at 13px, figures are tabular, numeric columns are right-aligned, and every typed entry (a host, a file name, a size, a count, a time, a rule pattern) is set in monospace so it reads as recorded data rather than prose. Actions are words with their keys beside them, sized for a mouse and mirrored on the keyboard. Motion is short and purposeful: a decided row folds shut and its title settles into the ledger below, so the manifest visibly empties.

The world is dark only. It rejects the sidebar, list and detail pane with icon tiles, the generic dark-SaaS look, glow effects and decorative icon tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground in four close steps; chrome sits one step darker than the manifest.
Hairline rules are the only structure. No cards, no shadows.
One cobalt ink for the chosen action and its states; brick only on recycle.
Public Sans for words, JetBrains Mono for typed data, tabular figures throughout.
Rectangular 4px controls labelled with words, each paired with its key.
One shared column template, so every figure lines up from header to total.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks the chosen action and the states that follow from it: selected, active, on, focused, applied, moved. It never decorates, never heads a section and never colours an inert word.

rules.name: The Suggestion Is Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Neat's suggestion always takes the cobalt slot, whatever its verb. "Recycle 5" as a suggestion is cobalt; brick belongs to the alternative Recycle button and to recycling already done.

rules.name: The Brick Is Recycle Rule
rules.body: Brick appears only on recycle. It is not a general danger, error or warning colour.

rules.name: The Plain Error Rule
rules.body: An error carries no icon and no colour. Its headline says what failed in Warm Off-White; its detail, in Pencil Grey, gives the recovery first and the reason after.

rules.name: The Ground Step Rule
rules.body: State is shown by stepping the ground (ground, then hover step, then selected step), never by adding a border, a tint of the accent or a glow.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for typed entries only: hosts, file names, sizes, counts, times, rule patterns, paths, version numbers. Never for labels, headings, prose or key caps.

rules.name: The Twelve Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 12px except the legend inside a key cap (10.5px).

rules.name: The Figures Align Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere and right-aligned in numeric columns, so sizes and counts read down the page like a ledger.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: The column header, every row, the loading placeholders, the total line and every expanded file line sit on one column template. A new column is added to the template, never to a single row.

rules.name: The Fixed Slot Rule
rules.body: Each action verb owns a slot and keeps it. A missing action leaves its slot empty rather than shifting its neighbours.

rules.name: The Fold, Don't Squeeze Rule
rules.body: When width runs out, secondary columns fold into the summary line in their own type (mono stays mono). Columns are never squeezed into truncated slivers.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Hairlines are the only structure. No cards, no filled panels, no boxed groups; if something needs separating, it gets a rule or a step of ground.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A surface that seems to need one needs a ground step instead.

dos: **Do** separate everything with 1px hairlines: Hairline between rows and lines, Header Rule under column headers and section headings.
**Do** show hover and selection by stepping the ground (row-hover, then row-selected), per the Ground Step Rule.

**Do** set hosts, file names, sizes, counts, times and rule patterns in JetBrains Mono at 12px wherever they stand as entries in a column, ledger or summary; figures inside a sentence stay in Public Sans.
**Do** keep figures tabular and right-align numeric columns.
**Do** write actions as words with their object ("Move to Receipts", "Recycle 5", "Keep") and pair each with its key cap on the selected row.
**Do** put every row, header, total and expanded file line on the one shared column template, and keep each action in its fixed slot.
**Do** open detail in place under its row, on the row's own columns.
**Do** fold secondary columns into the summary line at 1020px and below rather than squeezing them.
